llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is internally consistent with its purpose: it fetches a single book from a (configurable) Book-of-the-Day API and formats a short optimistic 'fortune' reading; it does not request unrelated credentials or perform unexpected actions.

dimensions.detail: The name/description match the runtime instructions: every invocation issues an HTTP GET to a configured BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL (defaulting to a public Vercel URL) to obtain a single book and then produces a short, language-aware reading. No unrelated binaries, credentials, or capabilities are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines itself to calling the book API, formatting a 3-part reading, optionally showing a cover image and an audio CTA, and handling language selection. It does not instruct the agent to read local files, harvest environment variables, or send data to arbitrary endpoints beyond the configured API and any cover/audio URLs returned by that API.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — only INSTALL.md with suggested clawhub/openclaw commands to register a cron push. This is a low-risk, instruction-only installation flow; the commands are standard for scheduling pushes and editing ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json to set the API URL.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials by default. Optional operator config keys (BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_AUDIO_BASE, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_LANGUAGE, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_SHOW_AUDIO) are proportional and directly related to the skill's behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. The INSTALL.md suggests adding a scheduled cron push, which is expected behavior for a daily-delivery skill; the skill does not request permanent elevated privileges or modification of other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its description, but consider a few practical privacy points before installing: the default API is an external service (book-of-the-day.vercel.app) and will receive a request each time the skill is invoked (and may log requests, IPs, timestamps, and returned cover/audio URLs). If you prefer not to query a third-party service, configure BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL to point at an API you control. Scheduled pushes (cron) will send messages to whatever channel you register (Telegram, Slack etc.); ensure those channel integrations are configured securely and that you trust the target channel. The skill may fetch cover images and audio links returned by the API — those requests will also go to external hosts. No credentials are required by the skill itself, and there are no install-time downloads or scripts beyond standard OpenClaw commands described in INSTALL.md.
